Create ONE high-fidelity portrait mobile UI mockup for Monyvi, an existing Egyptian finance app. It is an implementation-review mockup, not a new visual identity. Use a slim understated Android phone border, large readable screen occupying almost all the portrait canvas, no scenery, no giant outer margins, no title outside the device. Logical screen 390x844 dp. Existing Monyvi design bible: navy #0F172A background, slate #1E293B surfaces, #334155 separators, white primary text, #CBD5E1 secondary, #94A3B8 muted, emerald #10B981 actions, amber #FBBF24 pending warnings, red #F87171 expense amounts; ordinary Roboto-like sans, heading24dp/body14-16dp, 16dp horizontal margins, modest 8-12dp corner radii, consistent thin outline bank/mic/check icons. Flat compact transaction list rows separated by hairlines, NOT big rounded cards or decorative charts. No bottom tab bar; standalone review page, safe status bar and Android navigation region. Keep controls >=44dp visually.

State: Voice review, one proposed draft bank account QNB EGP used by exactly 3 transactions. None of the transactions selected. No account exists yet.
Top: 9:41 status bar, simple back arrow and title "Review transactions", small emerald "Retry" at right. A compact collapsed transcript row reading "What I heard" with microphone icon and chevron.
Then NEW one restrained slate surface group, heading "Suggested accounts". Row bank outline icon, "QNB" bold with small amber "New account"; second line "EGP · Used by 3 transactions". One short helper "Confirm once for all 3. Created only when you save." Next action row: primary emerald "Confirm account", quiet outlined "Change". This single shared confirmation is the feature focal point, not three repeated buttons.
Below group one unobtrusive hint "Selecting a transaction also confirms QNB for all 3."
Review mode strip using existing gold active tab: "All (3)" active, "Needs review (3)" other, "Selected (0)" other. One selection row "3 transactions" left / "Select all" right.
Three SAME-HEIGHT compact flat rows with empty square checkboxes at left. Merchant/description left and right-aligned red expense amount, muted "Today · 09:40" below, account row and tiny category:
1 "Lunch at Talabat" / "-120 EGP"; account "QNB · New account" amber; category "Food & drinks".
2 "Uber ride" / "-50 EGP"; account "QNB · New account" amber; category "Transport".
3 "Groceries" / "-320 EGP"; account "QNB · New account" amber; category "Shopping".
Rows have subtle edit chevron. All 3 clearly have unresolved pending account; none checked.
Fixed bottom action region with neutral "Discard all" and disabled muted "Save selected", safe inset.
Text must be exact and readable. Avoid green-tinted panels, glass, heavy gradients, oversize badges or decorative halos. No account balance invented. Keep user copy nontechnical.
